title: Comet
needAny: You lead a new sequence - play any card.

hint.comet: nothing else is playable, so spend the Comet
hint.king: a king stops the sequence and lets you lead the next one
hint.pass: nothing you hold can be played
hint.none: no move to recommend right now

tutorial.pile: Sequences climb **by rank and ignore suit entirely** - ♠5 → ♥6 → ♠7 is normal. Play the rank named as needed, or pass if you cannot. **There is no rule that a suit starts from the ace**: the leader plays any card.
tutorial.scores: Going out is worth **1 point, plus 1 for every card left in an opponent's hand, plus 2 for each king that never came out**. **A player left holding the Comet (9 of diamonds) loses a point.**
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. **Only playable cards can be picked.** The **9 of diamonds is the Comet** and stands in for any rank; playing it stops the sequence and lets you lead the next one.
tutorial.playButton: Pass appears only when nothing you hold is playable. When every seat passes, the last player to have played leads again.
tutorial.resetButton: The reset button starts a new game.
